answer: Because the timing is written down against the zenith challenge, the saffron audit can replay the pearl history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 57 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2793 identities would post 2697 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
